item.title: Digital twin tech offers ‘anti-involution’ strategies for China’s PV industry
item.description: PV Magazine — Researchers in China have developed a digital twin-based simulation framework to help PV manufacturers counter excessive price competition and declining profitability. The study found that combining moderate price increases with higher R&D investment could improve financial performance and long-term competitiveness, although the results remain unvalidated in real-world operations.

item.title: Silver-nickel contacts cut TOPCon rear metallization costs by 11%
item.description: PV Magazine — Chinese researchers developed a screen-printed silver-nickel paste that reduces rear-side metallization costs by approximately 11%. The optimized formulation achieved an average cell efficiency of 26.67% in a production trial, with a champion device reaching 26.87%.

item.title: Enerparc attracts more than 100 potential investors as insolvency sale moves forward
item.description: PV Magazine — More than 100 potential investors have expressed interest in insolvent German solar developer Enerparc, with initial bids already submitted and a first transaction targeted for December.
